newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat to visit Saudi Arabia to brief King Fahd.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to visit Saudi Arabia to brief King Fahd.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat travels on Tuesday to Saudi Arabia where he will brief King Fahd on the PLO-Israeli peace process, a Palestinian official said on Monday.
"President Arafat will leave tomorrow for Saudi Arabia to update King Fahd on obstacles in the peace process," said Nabil Abu Rdainah, Arafat's media adviser.
Arafat reiterated on Monday that he was determined to see agreed-upon self-rule deals with Israel implemented and warned Palestinians would not accept something imposed on them.

"We are adamant about the accurate implementation of what had been agreed upon," Arafat told reporters upon his return to Gaza from Egypt where he briefed President Hosni Mubarak on the stalled negotiations.
"No one should think that he could force the Palestinian people to accept things they cannot accept," he said without elaborating.
